caption: The video captures a tall clear plastic beverage dispenser with a dark maroon lid, filled with clear liquid, as white vapor steadily rises from a spout on the left. Two empty glass pitchers sit in the foreground and a lit red candle glows behind, though the camera pushes in until they drift toward the edges. A person in a dark blue top stands behind the dispenser with their hands clasped at the upper right. Those hands then separate and move leftward and downward to hover palms-down above the lid. The left hand settles just above the vapor-emitting spout without any clearly visible contact. The white vapor continues to rise and diffuse throughout, expanding as it ascends past the hovering fingers. The lid's right flap stays closed and the liquid level remains unchanged.
